title: Normalized lax tensor pairing for ringed direct image
statement: Let $(C,J),(D,K)$ be sites small relative to a fixed coefficient universe [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $v:C\to D$ induce direct image of sheaves by precomposition, let $R,S$ be commutative ring sheaves on $C,D$, and let $c:R\to v_*S$ be a unital ring-sheaf map. For $S$-module sheaves put $(PM)(U)=M(vU)$ with $R(U)$ acting through $c_U$, and let $P$ act on maps by precomposition [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use sheafified balanced tensors [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and regular modules as units, with their canonical associators and unitors [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. There is a unique lax monoidal structure on $P$ whose tensor map sends every local pure tensor $x\otimes y$ over $U$ to the local pure tensor $x\otimes y$ over $vU$. Here lax monoidal means natural maps $\mu_{M,N}:PM\otimes_RPN\to P(M\otimes_SN)$ and $e:R\to PS$ satisfying the associativity and both unit coherence identities. Its unit satisfies $e_U(r)=c_U(r)$ for every $U,r$.

proof.text: Use Mathlib pushforward c, which is precomposition with scalar restriction. Its regular-unit map is unitToPushforwardObjUnit c and its section formula is exactly c_U(r).

Construct the canonical bilinear pairing by the sheafification unit followed by tensorObjIsoSheafification.inv. Reuse restriction, naturality and associator formulas from the tensor generator calculus. Reuse the proved right-unitor pure-section formula of the cochain coherence construction; braiding gives the left-unitor formula. Apply bilinear transfer to construct the normalized pushforward tensorator.

Reuse the proved binary equality criterion of the scalar tensor construction imported by cochain coherence. Both naturality composites agree on pure tensors, so binary extensionality proves naturality in both variables. The left and right unit composites agree with the canonical unitors on pure tensors, using the coefficient map formula.

For the triple equality criterion, the canonical presheaf pairing m is a local equivalence: after sheafification both its unit and comparison factors are isomorphisms. The existing monoidal localization property implies m tensor id is a local equivalence too. Cancel its sheafification, compose with the tensor-sheafification comparison, and apply the sheafification adjunction. Two tensor inductions reduce equality to pure triples, using naturality of the sheafification unit. The two lax associativity composites then agree by the canonical associator section formula.

For a competing normalized lax structure, binary equality makes its tensorator equal to the constructed one. Evaluate its left-unit equation at the regular S-module on 1_R tensor 1_S. The pure-tensor and unitor formulas imply its unit sends 1_R to 1_S. R-linearity gives the coefficient-map formula on every r. Extensionality of lax structures proves uniqueness.
